claims.text: La Bahia sits where the tip of Monterey Bay touches Santa Cruz's Main Beach.

findings.quote: where the tip of Monterey Bay touches Santa Cruz’s coveted Main Beach

claims.text: The hotel faces Main Beach, with the Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk to the left and the Santa Cruz Wharf to the right.

findings.quote: La Bahia Hotel & Spa faces Main Beach, with the Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk⎯the oldest amusement park in California⎯to the left and the Santa Cruz Wharf to the right.

claims.text: The hotel is styled in Spanish-Mediterranean architecture.

findings.quote: Steeped in the romantic beauty of Spanish-Mediterranean architecture

claims.text: The hotel's roots date back nearly a century, to oceanfront apartments and a hotel designed by architect William C. Hays.

findings.quote: its roots date back nearly a century to when architect and UC Berkeley professor William C. Hays designed a community of oceanfront apartments and a hotel

claims.text: The original bell tower was restored.

findings.quote: the soon-to-be century-old bell tower was restored

claims.text: Guestrooms and suites have ocean views and pair a Spanish-Mediterranean aesthetic with a curated collection of worldly artifacts.

findings.quote: Pairing a Spanish-Mediterranean aesthetic with a curated collection of worldly artifacts, La Bahia’s ocean-view guestrooms and suites exude the warmth of a beloved friend’s private estate.

claims.text: Many Deluxe Rooms include balconies.

findings.quote: ## Deluxe Rooms
Artful seaside comforts and sublime views, many also include balconies to bask in the fresh ocean air.

claims.text: The Spa at La Bahia is inspired by Santa Cruz's original saltwater bathhouses.

findings.quote: Inspired by the original saltwater bathhouses and Mediterranean charm of Santa Cruz, The Spa at La Bahia is a holistic retreat

claims.text: The outdoor pool is heated and open year-round, with a hot tub.

findings.quote: Our outdoor pool is heated and accessible year-round. Relax in our hot tub

claims.text: High Tide is the hotel's signature restaurant, a Pacific Rim-inspired concept.

findings.quote: High Tide - La Bahia’s signature destination restaurant, a Pacific Rim-inspired concept

claims.text: The resort fee includes complimentary beach cruiser bicycles and beach chairs, based on availability.

findings.quote: complimentary beach cruiser bicycles and Tommy Bahama beach chairs based on availability

claims.text: Dogs and cats are permitted for a per-stay fee.

findings.quote: Pets (Dogs and Cats) are permitted with a $175.00 per stay fee.

claims.text: The Moorish spa offers a steam room, an ocean-view sauna, a co-ed relaxation area, a Zen deck and outdoor treatment rooms above the sand and sea.

findings.quote: our Moorish spa offers a steam room, ocean-view sauna, co-ed relaxation area, Zen deck and outdoor treatment rooms—poised above sand and sea.

claims.text: Beach butlers set up chairs, umbrellas and cooler bags on the sand for guests.

findings.quote: Beach butlers stake out sought-after spots in the sand for guests, setting up retro-inspired reclining chairs, umbrellas, cooler bags, and more.

claims.text: The Signature Suites are the largest suites, with ocean views, living and dining spaces and private furnished terraces.

findings.quote: ## Signature Suites
Our largest suites feature coveted ocean views with living/dining spaces and private, furnished terraces.

claims.text: The pool area has cabanas, fire pits and an infinity hot tub with views of the surf.

findings.quote: Primo views of the surf, cabanas, fire pits, and an infinity hot tub, provide even more reasons to linger longer.

claims.text: Guests can arrange surf lessons with local pro surfer Richie Schmidt.

findings.quote: Surf enthusiasts can hit the waves for a lesson with Santa Cruz local and pro surfer, Richie Schmidt

claims.text: A nightly resort fee applies.

findings.quote: La Bahia Hotel & Spa charges a nightly resort fee of $50.00

claims.text: Guests must be 18 or older to book.

findings.quote: Guests must be 18 and older to book.

claims.text: San Jose Mineta International Airport is the closest major airport.

findings.quote: San Jose Mineta International Airport (SJC) is approximately a 30-mile drive and the closest major airport
